description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Transdimensional Bovine.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Transdimensional Bovine.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Transdimensional Bovine.
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Transdimensional Bovine.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Transdimensional Bovine.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Transdimensional Bovine from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
